extracted.name: Crepes
extracted.description: First time tried crepes and put one secret.I filled them with jam,nutella and peanut butter. #12plates #happynewyear
instruction_lines: First blend banana by adding little milk and Mix all the ingredients well and by adding milk make a flowing thick mixture.make sure it shouldn't too thick or too watery.
Jam,nutella and peanut butter is very optional.grease your pan with butter and put little portion of mixture and spread it all around by moving gently your pan.
Let it cook at low heat and its again optional to cook from both sides.I half cooked one part then fill it and again cook other side.enjoy yumm crepes in my style.
